purpose: offline recorded-result synthesis; not a new experiment

methodology.metric: standard unique-query Q-error; not PRICE shifted Q-error
methodology.first_level: mean and sample SD over 5 support repeats within each initialization
methodology.second_level: arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of the three training-seed means; no pooling of query predictions
methodology.price_uncertainty: single supplied checkpoint; support SD only in per-initialization CSV; training-seed SD unavailable
methodology.pg: fixed existing estimates, no adaptation; K does not change values
methodology.execution: only local recorded JSON reads; no dataset/cache/checkpoint reads, server access, inference or training

p0.metric: Zero-shot unique-query Q95 by database and table-count bucket >=4 on the fixed source query plan. Per database, geometrically average long/short ratios across its >=4 buckets; geometrically average the three database ratios with equal database weights.

p1.metric: unique-query zero-shot q-error Q95, 4+ tables, macro over source validation
p1.training_pairing_scope: same seed across arms; not equality across seeds

p2.priority: deferred supplementary audit; blocked evidence retained
